title: A Cipher for the Safehouse
author: Tamsin Reyes
blurb: Sebastian Yarrow, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
